phase3_findings.description: src/sqllens/config.py:760-793: RuleSetsConfig.file can drift from the private _loaded it guards; the model is not frozen and has no validate_assignment, so setting file=None after load, pointing file at another path, or model_copy leaves the old loaded file in force. Invariant holds only by convention.

src/sqllens/safety/rule_sets.py:98-101: RuleSetRefusal.kind is a plain str that becomes client-facing text after 'Refused by the rule set:'; the type does not stop a caller passing a column name, which would reach the client unredacted. All current callers pass KIND_* constants.

src/sqllens/cli.py:99-119: _rule_set_file_configured returns False without logging on OSError/UnicodeDecodeError/TOMLDecodeError, so verify-memory prints the config error but omits VERIFY_MEMORY_UNSUPPORTED_MESSAGE; exit code is still 2.
